note: Curated civic advisories — the hyper-local road work / closures / emergency notices the live feeds (MDOT CHART = state highways, City press RSS) miss. Each renders in Pulse's 'Road work & closures' card alongside the press-release advisories, and self-expires by window (no stale alert ever ships). startsAt/expiresAt are ISO-8601 with offset. Keep this short; it is a human channel, not a feed.
